subject: Use the authored map box for MAP-movement condolence
description: RHElementActor::SendCondolationCard classifies a completed RHMOVE_MAP position with RHFastFindGrid::GetBoxMap().IsInside. Rust instead used fast-grid addressability, whose height includes four loader-padding rows beyond the authored map box, and therefore left Soldier55 active after it crossed the real map boundary. MAP-movement condolence now uses the inclusive authored map_bbox while retaining the padded grid for indexing. A focused boundary regression proves the authored bottom edge remains inside and the first padded-only row is outside; nicouzouf Profile_001 Savegame_065 replay-015 clears frame 836 and advances exactly through frame 1283 to an independent sound-manager pending-request panic.
